Glance 2026.09.29.1 improves footer customization, folder navigation and text copying.

- Customize footer fields with compact cards. Click or drag cards between enabled and disabled areas, and drag enabled cards to reorder them.
- Show available shooting parameters, camera details and text line endings. Media information includes color details, uses middle-dot separators and displays channel counts as `ch`.
- Start Word and Excel previews at a smaller zoom level.
- Navigate folder preview history with mouse back and forward buttons. Right-click inside the preview returns to the previous folder; an optional Window setting closes the preview when no previous folder is available. 3D previews retain their own right-click interaction.
- Copy selected text with Ctrl+C, middle-click or a translucent floating copy button, with a success notification. Text previews have no context menu.
- Copy structured JSON nodes with middle-click and inspect their paths in tooltips.
